discussion_comments.comment_body: format the json for multi-line here (and below) otherwise it will create unnecessary diffs if formatted later
We need to fix this throughout - so all of the places where you have single line objects/arrays.

The problem is due to VSC: if you deploy an ARM template and choose a format document with both ARM templates and prettier formatter, all arrays get formatted using ["a", "b"] format rather than 

["a",
 "b"
] format. I had to manually change about 40 arrays 😢

Move this above properties - See: https://github.com/Azure/azure-quickstart-templates/blob/master/1-CONTRIBUTION-GUIDE/best-practices.md#sort-order-of-properties for the proper sort order of properties
See: https://github.com/Azure/azure-quickstart-templates/blob/master/1-CONTRIBUTION-GUIDE/best-practices.md#sort-order-of-properties for the proper sort order of properties
